adjudication_guidelines.content: Background Check Adjudication Guidelines v3.1. CLEAR results: proceed to onboarding, mark 'Cleared'. CONSIDER results: do NOT auto-reject. HR must individually assess relevance to the role, recency, and severity, then prepare a recommendation for the hiring manager. Adverse-action steps (pre-adverse notice, candidate response window of 5 business days, final adverse notice) are mandatory before any rescission and require HR Director sign-off. No candidate may be contacted about results until adjudication is signed off.
